title: FBI Photo B019
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.image_type: black-and-white video or sensor display screenshot with crosshair reticle
pages.description: A grayscale image resembling a targeting or surveillance display with a grainy gray background. A white crosshair reticle is centered in the image, with horizontal and vertical measurement scales marked in numbers reading 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15. There is a small black dot near the center crosshair intersection. Several black rectangular blocks, appearing to be redactions or censored regions, are placed across the image: one large black bar spans the top, and six smaller black rectangles are arranged symmetrically in the left and right portions of the frame. Some of these rectangles have lighter gray extensions. A white timestamp is overlaid in the lower-left corner.
